Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner ignored the clear evidence that J. G. Farrell’s Empire Trilogy “deals with the political and human consequences of British colonial rule” and wrongly reasoned that, because Farrell was Anglo-Irish, “his country’s colonial rule” wouldn’t straightforwardly be British—thereby pivoting to Louis Aragon without support. This misinterpretation of nationality and dismissal of the gathered evidence led toward the wrong answer.
